universal.label: Singapore Police Emergency (999) / SCDF Ambulance & Fire (995)
universal.description: Dial 999 for Police Emergency or 995 for Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) Fire and Emergency Ambulance.

categories.name: Police & Public Safety
categories.description: 999 Singapore Police Force emergency, 70999 SMS emergency, and 1800-255-0000 hotline.

numbers.label: Singapore Police Force (SPF) Emergency
numbers.audience: Anyone in immediate danger, witnessing a crime in progress, or requiring urgent police intervention.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 999 immediately for urgent crimes or safety threats. If unsafe to speak, send an Emergency SMS to 70999.

numbers.label: SPF Police Hotline (Non-Emergency)
numbers.audience: Residents providing crime information or making non-urgent police inquiries.
numbers.whenToUse: Use when there is no immediate danger to life or property.

categories.name: Medical & Ambulance
categories.description: 995 SCDF Emergency Ambulance, 1777 Non-Emergency Ambulance, and 1767 SOS Crisis.

numbers.label: SCDF Emergency Medical Services (Ambulance)
numbers.audience: Patients experiencing life-threatening emergencies: cardiac arrest, stroke, breathlessness, trauma, or unconsciousness.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 995 only for critical medical emergencies so SCDF ambulances remain available for life-threatening cases.

numbers.label: Non-Emergency Ambulance Hotline
numbers.audience: Patients needing medical transport to a hospital or clinic for non-life-threatening conditions.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 1777 instead of 995 for minor injuries, stable fevers, or scheduled hospital transfers.

numbers.label: Samaritans of Singapore (SOS) Crisis Hotline
numbers.audience: Individuals in emotional crisis, feeling overwhelmed, or having thoughts of suicide.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 1767 anytime for confidential emotional support and crisis intervention.

categories.name: Fire & Hazmat Rescue
categories.description: 995 Singapore Civil Defence Force firefighting and rescue.

numbers.label: SCDF Fire & Rescue Dispatch
numbers.audience: Anyone reporting building fires, gas leaks, chemical spills, or trapped individuals.
numbers.whenToUse: Evacuate immediately and dial 995 to dispatch SCDF fire appliances and Red Rhino units.

numbers.label: National Anti-Violence & Sexual Harassment Helpline (NAVH)
numbers.audience: Victims or witnesses of domestic violence, child abuse, elder abuse, or sexual harassment.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 1800 777 0000 to report abuse or seek immediate social service protection (call 999 if in immediate physical danger).

categories.name: Cyber Scam & Expressway
categories.description: 1799 ScamShield Helpline and LTA Expressway EMAS recovery.

numbers.label: National Anti-Scam Helpline (ScamShield)
numbers.audience: Anyone who suspects they are being targeted by a scam or has transferred funds to a scammer.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 1799 immediately to verify if a call/link is a scam or to trigger bank anti-scam intervention.

numbers.label: LTA Expressway Monitoring & Advisory System (EMAS)
numbers.audience: Motorists experiencing vehicle breakdowns or obstructions on Singapore expressways and tunnels.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 1800-CALL-LTA for free EMAS tow-truck recovery to the nearest designated carpark on expressways.
